synapcores.title: SynapCores Gateway

apiKey.title: SynapCores API Key
apiKey.description: API key for the SynapCores gateway (ak_prod_... or aidb_...). May be omitted here and provided as SYNAPCORES_API_KEY instead.

useHttps.title: Use HTTPS
useHttps.description: Connect to the SynapCores gateway over TLS.

synapcores.description: SynapCores gateway connection. Optional at install time — the plugin installs without it and reports an actionable error at startup if the gateway is not reachable. apiKey may also be supplied via the SYNAPCORES_API_KEY environment variable.

collection.title: Memory Collection
collection.description: SynapCores collection name used to store memories.

graph.title: Memory Graph
graph.description: SynapCores graph name used for memory relations (SIMILAR_TO edges + recallRelated walks).

memory.title: Persistent Memory Object
memory.description: Controls for the CREATE MEMORY backend (SRS v1.2). Requires SynapCores engine v1.14.3-ce or newer; on older engines the plugin auto-detects and keeps using the legacy MEMORY_* namespace, so this whole block can be left unset. One exception: identityFrom 'credential' (the default) also needs an engine build that mints the memory_identity pin on login — with an API key, an admin token, or an engine that does not mint pins, set identityFrom to 'static' or 'host'.

backend.title: Memory Backend
backend.description: auto (default) probes the gateway once and uses the v1.14.3+ CREATE MEMORY object when available, falling back to the legacy MEMORY_* namespace. 'memory-object' fails loudly if the engine is too old; 'legacy' never probes.

name.title: Memory Object Name
name.description: Name of the CREATE MEMORY object. Defaults to the collection name. Must match ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ and be at most 64 characters, because it becomes part of the five backing table names.

identityField.title: Memory Identity Field
identityField.description: IDENTITY field used when the plugin creates the memory object. Ignored once the object exists — the gateway reads the field from the object itself.

identityFrom.title: Memory Identity Source
identityFrom.description: credential (default) = send no identity and let the gateway resolve the token's memory_identity pin; the plugin cannot address another identity because it never names one. Needs an ordinary user token — API keys and admin tokens are never pinned, and using one fails with MEMORY_CREDENTIAL_UNPINNED. static = one identity for this whole install (the same isolation the legacy namespace gave). host = derive per turn from the OpenClaw sender/session, for multi-user hosts.

identity.title: Memory Identity
identity.description: Identity value used when identityFrom is 'static' (defaults to 'default'), and the tool-call fallback when identityFrom is 'host'. Ignored in credential mode.

autoCreate.title: Auto-Create Memory Object
autoCreate.description: Create the memory object on first use when the gateway supports it but the object does not exist yet.

requireIsolation.title: Require Identity Isolation
requireIsolation.description: Fail rather than fall back to the legacy backend when per-identity isolation was requested. The legacy MEMORY_* namespace has no identity dimension — every identity shares it.

tokenBudget.title: Recall Token Budget
tokenBudget.description: token_budget passed to RECALL when injecting memory context into a prompt. When it is exceeded, lower-priority context is truncated and authoritative current state is preserved.

sourceType.title: Memory Source Type
sourceType.description: Claim authority recorded for memories written via memory_store. Conflict resolution considers it first: system_of_record > verified_user_statement > user_statement > tool_result > agent_derivation > agent_inference.

autoCapture.title: Auto-Capture (opt-in)
autoCapture.description: Opt-in; default off. When enabled, the plugin automatically stores conversation-derived facts to your SynapCores gateway and turns on pre-compaction memory flushing. Leave off (the default) to keep the plugin passive — memory is written only when you explicitly call memory_store or the `ltm` command.

autoRecall.title: Auto-Recall (opt-in)
autoRecall.description: Opt-in; default off. When enabled, the plugin automatically injects relevant stored memories into the model's context on each turn. Leave off to recall only when you explicitly call memory_recall.

autoLinkSimilar.title: Auto-Link Similar Memories (opt-in)
autoLinkSimilar.description: Opt-in; default off. Only applies when autoCapture is enabled. On capture, draws SIMILAR_TO graph edges to existing memories with cosine similarity > 0.7 so recallRelated returns useful neighborhoods (adds ~30-50ms per capture).

workspace.title: Workspace ID
workspace.description: Optional workspace name suffixed onto the AutoML relevance model so multiple installations sharing one gateway can train independent models.
